title: Aperture Finance instant-liquidity router — path live, value $0; one funded ERC-20 approval frozen by token pause

The only funded ERC-20 approval (3,477,020.1 TRU) is on a globally paused token; transferFrom reverts ERC20Pausable: token transfer while paused

key_facts: Router 0xD83d960deBEC397fB149b51F8F37DD3B5CFA8913 is non-proxy (EIP-1967 impl slot 0) with 38,888-hex-char runtime on ETH/ARB/OP/POLY

Selector 0x67b34120 is still in the runtime; exploit tx 0x7d2c160d... at block 25,803,114 status 1 moved NFT tokenId 0xd188b from 0xc846d321... to caller 0xfcbe6aa9... via NFPM.transferFrom called by the router

Only 8 pairs have allowance>0 and balance>0: 1 on Ethereum (TRU), 7 on Polygon (dust)
TRU owner 0x530a445c... holds 3,477,020.105893728270632095 TRU with ~2^256 allowance to the router, but TRU paused() == true since block 24,192,375
TRU nominal at CoinGecko $0.00507041 = $17,629.92; only visible market is MEXC with $55,850/24h volume; on-chain Uniswap V2 pair holds only 0.02058 WETH

caveats: Router is closed source; ERC-20-target variant of the bug rests on cited public analyses, while the NFT-transfer path is proven by the live trace
TRU unpause is controlled by the token DEFAULT_ADMIN/PAUSER EOA 0x39e6918d... (single key), so the $17.6k nominal is a latent privileged-conditional, not live E-U
Realizable value of 3.48M TRU at size is likely below nominal and possibly below $10k due to thin MEXC depth
ApprovalForAll operator grants were not exhaustively enumerated; the one non-empty OP position was checked directly and is not approved
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0.00 live: the proven arbitrary transferFrom path remains but every approved NFT position is empty, and the only materially funded ERC-20 approval is on a paused token (nominal $17.6k latent, admin-gated).
